notes: Five serial fresh-profile cold-cache Lighthouse runs per phase and device condition: twenty primary comparison runs. Twenty earlier candidate runs are also retained in performance/iteration-1 and performance/iteration-2, for forty raw runs total. Same Chrome executable, viewports, theme defaults and throttling configuration. No concurrent heavy QA during measurements.
Mobile is 390x844, DPR 1.75, light, simulated 150ms RTT / 1638.4Kbps / 4x CPU. Desktop is 1440x900, DPR 1, dark, simulated 40ms RTT / 10240Kbps / 1x CPU.
Raw reports, traces and network logs, including slower runs, remain in portfolio-audit/performance/.

Host benchmark medians differ, especially on mobile. Score and timing deltas are observed laboratory results; their size cannot be attributed entirely to the code changes. Reduced request and script bytes are directly observed.
The hero poster remains the mobile LCP image. Desktop nodes are retained per run in raw insights.
No field INP or physical-device performance result is available. Intent-driven 3D/video startup is excluded from navigation measurements and is not claimed to be free.
